title.zh: 上线十二个生活口语场景

purpose.en: Give anonymous beginners a free, visual, listen-and-repeat route into practical spoken language while correcting the responsive header so the hamburger is the only separate mobile action.
purpose.zh: 为匿名初学者提供免费、图像化、听读跟练的实用口语入口，同时修正响应式页头，使汉堡按钮成为移动模式唯一的独立操作。

en: Add Airport, Hotel, Restaurant, Hospital, Coffee shop, School, Library, Grocery store, Train and metro, Pharmacy, Bank, and Police help desk scenes.
Provide twelve automatic slides in every scene for each of SmartLingo's twelve target languages, using the existing reviewed survival-language forms and pronunciation guides.
Add local AI-generated scene art, target-language speech synthesis, repeat-after-me prompts, transient browser speech scoring, replay, pause, quit, and complete slide navigation.
Replace the Course detail back button with a language-preserving Everyday Speaking entry.
zh: 新增机场、酒店、餐厅、医院、咖啡店、学校、图书馆、食品店、车站、药店、银行和警察服务台场景。
每个场景为 SmartLingo 十二种目标语言分别提供十二张自动幻灯片，复用现有已审核的生存口语与音标数据。
加入本地原创 AI 场景图、目标语言语音示范、跟我读提示、浏览器内临时口语评分、重玩、暂停、退出和完整翻页控制。
将课程详情页的返回按钮替换为保留目标语言参数的生活口语入口。
新增 /:lang/play/everyday 场景库与播放器

en: At the 1100-pixel hamburger breakpoint, hide the separate desktop account area and language control while retaining the full account area inside the drawer.
Organize each lesson as polite opening, scene essentials, and task completion, aligned to beginner immediate-need communication.
Keep anonymous lesson progress and pronunciation scores page-local with no database writes.
zh: 在 1100 像素汉堡断点同步隐藏独立桌面账户区与语言控件，完整账户入口仍保留在抽屉内。
每课按礼貌开场、场景关键词和完成基本任务组织，符合初学者即时需求沟通目标。
匿名课程进度和发音分数仅保留在当前页面，不写入数据库。

en: All twelve languages, twelve scenes, twelve slides per scene, images, pronunciation fields, player controls, and course links are covered by regression tests.
Production build, sensitive-data scan, and artifact validation pass.
Chrome responsive checks cover 390x844, 430x932, 820x1180, 1180x820, and 1440x900 without horizontal overflow.
zh: 回归测试覆盖十二种语言、十二个场景、每场十二张幻灯片、图片、音标、播放器控件和课程入口。
生产构建、敏感数据扫描和发布产物验证通过。

en: Automatic pronunciation scoring depends on browser SpeechRecognition support; listening and manual repeat practice remain available when it is unsupported or microphone permission is denied.
zh: 自动发音评分取决于浏览器 SpeechRecognition 支持；不支持或麦克风未授权时，听读与人工跟练仍可正常使用。

en: The Everyday Speaking feature is SmartLingo-specific; only the generic responsive-header contract was audited across the portfolio.
zh: 生活口语属于 SmartLingo 专属功能；跨站审计仅覆盖通用响应式页头契约。
